Hi, Stephanie. I am Peter Hall. I lead the trauma research group here in Maryland.
Nice to meet you, Peter. Thank you for making the time.
Of course. I work with international doctors every year, and it is my favorite part of the job.
That is good to hear. I am a little nervous about my English.
You are doing fine. Tell me about your background.
My degree is in medicine, and I trained in trauma surgery. Right now I am working with data and artificial intelligence in healthcare.
That is unusual, and very useful. Are you responsible for the analysis, or for the medical side?
Both, in a way. My role is to bridge the two teams. I explain the operation to the engineers, and the technology to the doctors.
I am a doctor. My degree is in medicine, and I trained in trauma surgery.
Right now I am working with data and artificial intelligence in healthcare.
My role is to bridge the medical team and the IT team.
I am responsible for turning the data into something doctors can use.
That is a good question. Let me think for a second.

Good morning, everyone. My name is Daniel Reyes, and I am a physician by training. I worked in emergency medicine for nine years, and then I moved to the analytics team at a health insurance company. Right now I am responsible for a project that uses data to decide which patients need care first. My role is not easy to explain at a party. I am a doctor who does not see patients anymore, and I am an engineer without an engineering degree. But I like the position, because I sit between two worlds, and I speak both languages.

Hi, this is Karen from the international office at the medical school. I am calling about your application. Right now we are reviewing the documents of all the candidates, and your file is almost complete. We still need one thing: a short letter in English where you describe your background, your current role, and why you want to spend time with our research team. It does not need to be long. Two paragraphs are enough. Please send it before the end of the month. If you have any questions, call me back at this number. Thank you, and have a good day.
